name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v546: fixes the Cloudflare challenge WebView never loading. (1) Restored the full provider/extractor stack that v541-v544 accidentally deleted (all built-in providers, all extractor APIs, all four MainAPIs, dynamic API URL init). (2) Fixed the challenge URL being built as 'https://https://animepahe.pw/' for API endpoints, which made the WebView load nothing. (3) Fixed the Cloudflare cookie purge using an invalid domain ('https://animepahe.pw' instead of 'animepahe.pw'), so stale cf_clearance cookies are actually cleared and Cloudflare issues a fresh challenge. (4) Visible path now reports completion back to the probe. (5) Phisher-ported WebView UI, invisible/visible toggle, app-open auto-bypass and cookie reuse retained.
